Welcome to Tay Township: Week of Welcome Municipal Open House

Tay Township Municipal Office450 Park St, Victoria Harbour, ON L0K 2A0, Canada

17sep5:30 pm6:30 pmWelcome to Tay Township: Week of Welcome Municipal Open House5:30 pm - 6:30 pm(GMT+01:00) Tay Township Municipal Office, 450 Park St, Victoria Harbour, ON L0K 2A0, Canada

Event Details

Join us for an evening of connection and community! As part of Simcoe County’s Week of Welcome, Tay Township is hosting an Open House for residents of all ages. 

Event Details

Join us for an evening of connection and community! As part of Simcoe County’s Week of Welcome, Tay Township is hosting an Open House for residents of all ages. 

Date: Thursday, September 17, 2026
Time: 5:30 p.m. to 6:30 p.m.
Location: Tay Township Municipal Office, 450 Park Street, Victoria Harbour 

Whether you’ve lived in Tay Township for 30 years or 30 days, this is your chance to: 

  • Meet Township staff and ask questions one-on-one

  • Learn about local services and projects

  • Find out how to stay informed and get involved 

Please note that not all departments will be in attendance, but there will still be a wide range of helpful information and resources available 

All residents are welcome. Let’s build a stronger, more connected Tay Township. 

Contact: 

Elizabeth Smith
Manager of Communications and Technology Services 
705-534-7248 ext. 264 
esmith@tay.ca
